short: The protobuf API contract, authoritative over both tiers
is: The API contract — protobuf as the independent IDL, authoritative over BOTH tiers (axum via prost+pbjson, SvelteKit via protobuf-es), owned by neither and generated into both.
conventions: JSON over HTTP is the v1 transport — nothing here implies gRPC; transports are adapters.
`service`/`rpc` blocks exist only to host `google.api.http` annotations; ONLY MESSAGES are generated, handlers stay hand-written but return the generated types.
Path-major is welded to the package: `zurfur.api.v1` ⇒ `/api/v1/…`.
Additive-only within a major; `buf breaking` at WIRE_JSON, the skip label is banned (R9).
R6 ids opaque (≤64-char strings; a DID ≤2048; a Den path segment is a key, not an id).
R8 vocabularies are documented extensible `string`s, never enums.
Serializer options are contract text pinned by `golden_wire.rs`.
`golden/` holds recorded answers: generated files are regenerated, never patched; hand-written fixtures are marked as such.

fs.name: README.md
fs.role: orientation: authority claim, layout, the rules in one breath

fs.name: VERSIONING.md
fs.role: the binding versioning/deprecation contract: rulings R1–R11, breaking-change list, 12-month notice

fs.name: buf.yaml
fs.role: v2 module config — lint STANDARD, breaking gate WIRE_JSON

fs.name: golden/
fs.role: golden responses for the web's decoder tests; den/ is regenerated by `just den-golden` (drift-checked by the api's den_golden test), its handwritten/ card fixtures marked in its README.md and index.json; name-ordinals.json is hand-written, the shared cases of the rule that numbers equal names in one Den folder (each case's entries in listing order, each visible or hidden, with its expected ordinal or null), read by Atta's ordinal tests and by the web's name-ordinals.spec.ts, and kept outside den/ so the golden check and the web's golden spec never take it for a recorded answer; segments.json is hand-written too, the shared cases of the node segment rule (accepted and refused, a long case as repeat and times), read by Atta's segment tests, kernel's NodeSegment tests and adapter-pg's node_segment_shape test — the shared segment cases, not a golden answer, so it also stays outside den/

fs.name: google/
fs.role: vendored googleapis annotations (api/annotations.proto, api/http.proto) — verbatim upstream, never edited

fs.name: lifecycle.toml
fs.role: per-major lifecycle manifest ([major.v1] live|deprecated|sunset); CI routes follow it; pre-release ends at the first alpha tag

fs.name: zurfur/
fs.role: the Zurfur corpus; pass-through to api/v1

notes: CI job `contract` runs lint + breaking + the clean-slate generate diff.
